_doc: The aim-train range far above the surf course. Lengths in metres, positions in the range frame: origin at 'center', turned range_yaw about y (x right, y up, z toward the spawn; lanes run toward -z). Distances are measured from the firing line. Bot size is movement.json hull_height (72 u), so 'parts' and 'props' positions are fractions of that height in the bot's own frame (x to its left as you face it, z toward the player). A part is a hittable body in a hitgroup; a prop is a mesh riding on a part, drawn when its 'when' is 'always' or one of the outfit's 'gear' tags (one outfit today: every bot wears the same kit, as every aim_botz bot wears the same agent). Shapes: sphere (centre a, radius r; b unused), taper or capsule (from a to b, radius r at a and r2 at b), beam (a box from a to b, r half wide, r2 half tall), box (centre a, size b), cylinder (centre a, height b.y). k scales the drawn mesh in the shape's own axes (x across, y along a to b, z depth); the hitbox is the undrawn shape, or the box 'hit' gives as [centre x, y, z, size x, y, z]. Time to kill runs from the shot that first hit that bot to its death (a one-tap is 0 ms); the kill interval runs from the later of the bot standing up (or the round starting) and your previous kill, and a second kill by the same shot adds no interval.
